title: Fubini identity along the k-th coordinate of the cube Q_δ (parent step 3)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, δ ∈ ℝ, k ∈ Fin (m + 1), Q_δ := {y ∈ Euclid (m + 1) : δ < y_i < 1 − δ for all i}, and let h : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ be integrable on Q_δ. For x ∈ Euclid (m + 1) and t ∈ ℝ let x[k ↦ t] be x with its k-th coordinate replaced by t. Then ∫_{Q_δ} ∫_{(δ, 1 − δ)} h(x[k ↦ t]) dt dx = (1 − 2δ)·∫_{Q_δ} h.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) (k : Fin (m + 1)) (h : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ), IntegrableOn h {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ} → ∫ x in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}, ∫ t in Ioo δ (1 - δ), h (WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.update (WithLp.ofLp x) k t)) = (1 - 2 * δ) * ∫ x in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}, h x
